required_fixes: Redesign behavioral_score function to produce continuous, differentiated scores across drift types (permission_boundary, session_invalidation, token_refresh). Current weights (0.3+0.2=0.5 for permission_boundary; 0.3+0.2=0.5 for session_invalidation; 0.05+0.15+0.2=0.4 for token_refresh) produce near-identical or identical totals.

Fix server state management: set_drift() must fully reset all server state (current_role, session_valid, drift_active, drift_type) before activating new drift. Current implementation carries over current_role="viewer" and session_valid=False across conditions, contaminating subsequent measurements.

Replace deterministic WSGI mock server with stochastic server matching EXP-GRAPH-35353011131 (Flask + SQLite WAL-mode DB + cache TTL + I/O jitter + mixed JWT algorithms) to produce behavioral variance. The current deterministic server yields zero behavioral variance (std=0.0), making orthogonality assessment impossible.

Ensure behavioral signal has non-zero variance within each co-occurring condition before running orthogonality test. Frozen C2_Variance control from EXP-GRAPH-35353011131 required >=6 of 8 conditions with std>0 for both signals; this experiment has 0 of 12 conditions with behavioral std>0.

Document C-PRODUCT-ECON closure rationale separately from C-FRESHNESS integration test. The experiment was designed to test C-FRESHNESS, not to close C-PRODUCT-ECON. Closure decision requires Director verdict on full evidence chain including 4 prior experiments with zero real LLM calls.
validity_findings: C3 orthogonality test is MEASUREMENT_INVALID: behavioral variance = 0.0 across all 720 co-occurring samples (std=0.0), making Pearson r undefined (NaN) and TOST equivalence test inapplicable. This is a measurement design flaw, not a scientific falsification of signal independence.

Behavioral_score function produces constant 0.5 for all three drift types in co-occurring conditions due to: (a) scoring weight collisions (permission_boundary=0.5, session_invalidation=0.5, token_refresh=0.4 but measured as 0.5 due to state carry-over), (b) server state not reset between conditions (current_role="viewer" persists from permission_boundary into session_invalidation and token_refresh conditions), (c) deterministic server lacks stochastic variation that produced behavioral variance in EXP-GRAPH-35353011131.

Server state contamination confirmed: COOCURRING iteration order (permission_boundary first) sets current_role="viewer" which persists into session_invalidation and token_refresh conditions. session_invalidation sets session_valid=False which persists into token_refresh. JWT tokens generated with stale current_role value.

Structural signal IS valid and varies (struct_variance=7.74, struct_std=2.78), replicating EXP-RUNTIME-33902315583 full-vector discrimination of 0.8333 exactly. Expired_token and invalid_token correctly produce identical fingerprints (137257c6fb39bf53).

Behavioral TP (C2) passes (1.0) but measured in Phase 6 with isolated drift+no_noise conditions where state is properly set per drift type. This does not generalize to co-occurring conditions where state carry-over occurs.
Null control (C4) passes (FP=0.0 on 240 noise-only samples) but noise-only conditions run after drift conditions with drift cleared, so server state is reset to defaults.
Positive control (C1) replicates EXP-RUNTIME-33902315583 exactly (0.8333 discrimination, same fingerprint collision pattern), confirming HTTP fingerprint substrate works on this mock kernel.

Experiment uses deterministic WSGI server (wsgiref.simple_server) with no stochastic elements, unlike EXP-GRAPH-35353011131 which used Flask+SQLite+cache+jitter+mixed JWT and achieved behavioral_std 0.14-0.43 across conditions. The frozen measurement_validity claim "Behavioral signals use validated graded session_status_check pattern from EXP-GRAPH-35353011131" is invalidated by substrate mismatch.
N=720 paired samples exceeds frozen N>=480 requirement, but sample quality is compromised by zero behavioral variance.

C-PRODUCT-ECON closure is NOT tested by this experiment. The experiment tests C-FRESHNESS integration only. The parent handoff's three-way decision (close C-PRODUCT-ECON / provision LLM / redirect to C-FRESHNESS) requires Director verdict on full evidence chain.
baseline_findings: B-FRESHNESS-STRUCTURAL: PASS. Full-vector discrimination 0.8333 > 0.5 threshold. Matches EXP-RUNTIME-33902315583 exactly (discrimination 0.833, intra=1.0, inter=0.1667). Expired/invalid token fingerprint collision is correct substrate behavior.

B-FRESHNESS-BEHAVIORAL: PARTIAL. TP=1.0 >= 0.85 threshold met in isolated drift detection (Phase 6), but behavioral signal lacks variance for orthogonality testing in co-occurring conditions (Phase 4). Baseline from EXP-GRAPH-35353011131 (TP=1.0, FP=0.0, AUC=1.0, orthogonality confirmed at delta=0.15) used stochastic server with behavioral variance; this experiment's deterministic server fails to replicate the variance condition.
B-STATUS-ONLY: 0.5 (3 auth states share status 401). B-BODY-ONLY: 0.8333 (matches full-vector). Both consistent with EXP-RUNTIME-33902315583.

B-COLD-ANALYTICAL and B-PARAMETERIZED-ANALYTICAL: Not re-measured in this experiment (carried forward from EXP-PRODUCT-35330741529). Correctly noted as analytical estimates with zero real LLM calls across 4 consecutive experiments.
claim_ceiling: C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL with structural signal validated (C1 passes, discrimination 0.8333) and behavioral drift detection validated in isolation (C2 passes, TP=1.0), but orthogonality of behavioral+structural signals UNTESTED due to measurement invalidity (behavioral variance=0.0). C-PRODUCT-ECON closure NOT addressed by this experiment. Maximum justified claim: HTTP fingerprint substrate discriminates auth states on mock SPIDER kernel; behavioral signal detects drift in isolated conditions; noise FP=0.0. Orthogonality claim requires re-run with stochastic server and differentiable behavioral scoring.
evidence_refs: codex/experiments/EXP-GRAPH-35353011131/result.json (orthogonality baseline with stochastic server, r=0.046, CI upper 0.135 < 0.15)
